item.title: Hacktron AI Uses Claude to Breach OpenAI Systems
item.description: Hacktron AI used Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5 to chain a libheif memory bug, hijacking OpenAI’s Discourse forum and stealing ChatGPT and Codex accounts.
